answer: Cross-chain identity binding at the zenith: one agent identity must be provably controlled across N chains via a signed challenge, so each new chain costs a fresh keypair plus gas and bridge fees. The pearl is a reputation score that decays if the same wallet cluster reappears. Any farm seeding k identities hits the inlet where marginal cost exceeds reward, capping cheap sybils near zero. It works because duplication is priced, not assumed away.
